meaning: 'verified' means an independent reader attested every item against the source. It does not upgrade any compliance claim, and the script cannot prove the reader's independence - it records the attestation.

verifier.statement: I extracted and read all 8 pages of ohchr-udhr-english.pdf directly with pdftotext, page by page, and read the accessible HTML rebuild and its accessibility report in full. I compared wording verbatim, heading levels, ordered-list item counts and order, and data-source-page attributions for every worksheet item, and checked each disclosed transformation (Article I Roman numeral, cross-page rejoins, heading/list page splits) against the source. All 57 items matched.
